2610.09456.title: GeoPrior-Mamba: Structured Process Priors with Mamba for Fine-Resolution XCO2 Reconstruction
2610.09456.paper_summary: Reconstructing fine-resolution column-averaged dry-air CO2 (XCO2) fields from sparse satellite observations requires models to infer spatial structure that is only weakly constrained by direct measurements. Existing learning-based methods typically treat environmental covariates as ordinary numerical inputs and must therefore learn heterogeneous source-sink relationships largely from sparse supervision. We introduce GeoPrior-Mamba, a multi-directional Mamba framework augmented with offline language-model-induced structured process priors. Rather than using a language model to predict XCO2, we use it before training to organize relative process knowledge for biospheric uptake, ecosystem respiration, and anthropogenic emissions into deterministic prior tables. These priors are spatially instantiated using geographic, ecological, emission-related, and seasonal information and are adaptively injected into the reconstruction backbone through a lightweight knowledge adapter. Using OCO-2 observations from 2018-2020, GeoPrior-Mamba achieves an RMSE of 0.81 ppm and an R2 of 0.93 on held-out observations, reducing RMSE by 48.2% relative to CAMS background interpolation and by 3.1% relative to Trans-XCO2 under the same evaluation protocol. Ablation experiments show a measurable contribution from the knowledge-prior branch and substantially faster convergence than the knowledge-free Mamba backbone. Independent TCCON evaluation further supports the consistency of the reconstructed fields with ground-based column CO2 measurements. These results suggest that language models can provide a practical mechanism for constructing structured process priors when globally consistent process-response representations are difficult to obtain directly, while remaining outside the numerical prediction loop.
2610.09456.paper_summary_zh: 重建來自稀疏衛星觀測的高解析度柱平均乾空氣二氧化碳 (XCO2) 場需要模型推斷空間結構，而這些結構僅受到直接測量的弱約束。現有的基於學習的方法通常將環境協變數視為普通數值輸入，因此必須從稀疏的監督中學習異質的源-匯關係。我們介紹了 GeoPrior-Mamba，一個多方向的 Mamba 框架，增強了離線語言模型引導的結構過程先驗。與其使用語言模型來預測 XCO2，我們在訓練之前使用它來組織生物圈吸收、生態系統呼吸和人為排放的相對過程知識，並將其整理成確定性先驗表。這些先驗使用地理、生態、排放相關和季節性信息進行空間實例化，並通過輕量級知識適配器自適應地注入到重建骨幹中。使用 2018-2020 年的 OCO-2 觀測，GeoPrior-Mamba 在保留的觀測上達到了 0.81 ppm 的 RMSE 和 0.93 的 R2，相對於 CAMS 背景插值減少了 48.2% 的 RMSE，並相對於 Trans-XCO2 在相同評估協議下減少了 3.1%。消融實驗顯示知識先驗分支有可測量的貢獻，並且收斂速度明顯快於無知識的 Mamba 骨幹。獨立的 TCCON 評估進一步支持重建場與基於地面的柱 CO2 測量的一致性。這些結果表明，當全球一致的過程-反應表示難以直接獲得時，語言模型可以提供構建結構化過程先驗的實用機制，同時保持在數值預測循環之外。
